Save this spam trigger list ↓
Gmail’s filter flags ‘free,’ ‘discount,’ and ‘urgent’ in subject lines, costing 40% of opens. Swap them for ‘exclusive’ or ‘early access’ to stay in the inbox.
#emailmarketingtips #emaildeliverability #marketingaudit #irishstartup
carousels.hook: Gmail buries your email if it sees ‘free’ in the subject
carousels.throughline: Gmail’s spam filter flags specific words in your subject line, sending emails straight to spam instead of the inbox.

reel_beats.hook: Gmail buries your email if it sees one word

body.text: Gmail’s spam filter scans subject lines for words like ‘free,’ ‘discount,’ and ‘urgent,’ and flags them instantly.
These words appear in 60% of emails marked as spam, so Gmail’s system treats them as red flags.
Emails with these words get 40% fewer opens, even if they land in the inbox.
Replace them with ‘exclusive’ or ‘early access’ and test in Gmail’s ‘Spam’ tab before sending.

reel_beats.send_line: Send this to your email marketer

Emails with these words see 40% fewer opens.
Use Gmail’s Postmaster Tools to check your spam rate.

carousels.caption:
Save this reply checklist ↓
Gmail moves emails with replies to Primary—opens don’t count. A single reply beats 100 opens for inbox placement. Ask questions and personalize to boost engagement.
#emailmarketingtips #emaildeliverability #conversiontracking #corkbusiness
carousels.hook: Gmail moves emails with replies to Primary—opens don’t count
carousels.throughline: Gmail prioritizes emails that spark replies over those that just get opens, moving them to the Primary tab.

reel_beats.hook: Gmail ignores opens—only replies get you inbox placement

body.text: Gmail’s algorithm tracks replies, not just opens, to decide where your email lands.
Emails that spark replies are 3x more likely to land in the Primary tab, not Promotions.
Generic emails get 50% fewer replies than personalized ones, so Gmail buries them.
Ask a question in your subject line and add ‘Reply to this email’ to your CTA to boost replies.

reel_beats.send_line: Send this to your email team

body_slides.text: Gmail’s algorithm tracks replies, not opens, for inbox placement.

carousels.hook: Google Ads hides half your sales in a report you’ve never opened
carousels.throughline: Google Ads’ ‘Attribution’ report shows where half your sales actually come from, but most advertisers never check it.

reel_beats.hook: Google Ads hides half your sales in a report you’ve never opened

body.text: The ‘Attribution’ tab in Google Ads shows the full customer journey, not just the last click.
Most accounts miss 40% of conversions because they only track last-click data, ignoring earlier touchpoints.
Switch to ‘Data-driven’ attribution to see which ads actually drive sales, not just clicks.
Check the report weekly to spot trends and shift budget to ads that convert, not just generate traffic.

carousels.hook: Meta’s algorithm favors 200 engaged users over 20k lookalikes
carousels.throughline: A small, highly engaged audience of 200 people can outperform a 20k lookalike because Meta’s algorithm prioritizes engagement over size.

reel_beats.hook: Meta’s algorithm favors 200 engaged users over 20k lookalikes

body.text: Meta’s algorithm prioritizes engagement over audience size, so a small, engaged audience can convert 3x better.
Lookalikes often include cold or irrelevant users, which dilutes ad performance and wastes budget.
Small audiences allow Meta to find more people like your best customers, boosting conversions.
Test a 200-person custom audience against your 20k lookalike to see which performs better.

carousels.caption:
Save this bounce fix ↓
Google Ads bills you for clicks that bounce in 3 seconds—enable ‘View-through conversions’ to stop paying for wasted clicks and cut spend by 25%.
#googleadstips #ppc #marketingaudit #irishbusiness
carousels.hook: Google Ads bills you for clicks that bounce in 3 seconds
carousels.throughline: Google Ads charges for clicks that never fully load, but a simple setting change stops billing for 3-second bounces.

reel_beats.hook: Google Ads charges you for clicks that never fully load

body.text: Google Ads bills you for clicks even if the user leaves within 3 seconds, wasting up to 25% of your budget.
Enable ‘View-through conversions’ in Settings → Conversions to only pay for engaged visits.
This change applies instantly and doesn’t require a new campaign setup, so you can fix it today.
Check your ‘Bounce rate’ report weekly to track improvements after enabling the setting.

reel_beats.send_line: Send this to your PPC team

body_slides.text: Google Ads charges for clicks even if users leave in 3 seconds.
Enable ‘View-through conversions’ to pay only for engaged visits.
This setting cuts wasted spend by up to 25%.
Go to Settings → Conversions → ‘View-through conversions’ to enable.
The change applies instantly—no new campaign needed.
Check your ‘Bounce rate’ report weekly to track improvements.
